blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The Toledo Xignex Trojans came agonizingly close to capturing their first-ever Wesley So Cup title in the Professional Chess Association of the Philippines (PCAP) but fell short against Manila AQ Prime Assets in a closely contested championship showdown on Wednesday night, November 25. The Trojans settled for their second consecutive runner-up finish in the country’s premier online-based professional chess tournament, which features some of the country’s top players alongside foreign chess masters. Manila secured the championship with a combined 21.5 points from their back-to-back matches, just one point ahead of Toledo’s 20.5 in a tightly fought battle that […]...
